entries.title: Update Infinitary on your other computers, iPhone and iPad
entries.body: This version changes how your computers work together again. A computer that runs work for you takes no new work until it runs this version too, and you can update it from Devices. A computer, iPhone or iPad that controls your first mate can look but not change anything until it is updated.
entries.noPicture: This changes which versions of Infinitary work together, not the layout or words of a screen.

exclusions.reason: Release review for the alpha after 0.5.0-alpha.9: ranks the Anything else? box, Review carefully and the protocol 11 update; adds that update's note; names your first mate in three notes; drops Pi and Claude Code from two; rewords the Careful proof and crowded-rails notes; folds the second smooth-typing note into the first. Nothing in the app changes.
Documentation and code comments only: the docs and two comments describe the shapes and behavior the code has today. Nothing in the app changes.
Test only: the record controls journey opens a task's record in a narrow window before the side rails fold its Tasks panel. Nothing in the app changes.
